    The database at a glance

    How the data was cleaned

    • Names – titles (Mr./Ms./Dr.) moved to Salutation; names split into First / Middle / Last; ALL-CAPS and lower-case names fixed. Initials stay with the first name (e.g. "K P Singh" → First "K P", Last "Singh").
    • Shared cells – cells naming two people (e.g. "Hiren Shah / Mehul Chauhan") were split into separate contacts.
    • Phone numbers – all numbers in +91 format; mobiles separated from landlines and office numbers; extra mobiles go to Alternate Mobile(s). Numbers typed in the email column (and vice versa) were moved to the right place.
    • Duplicates – rows merged when the same person appeared at the same company (allowing spellings like Agarwal/Agrawal and Pvt Ltd/Limited), or when matching names shared the same email or mobile. Different people sharing one company inbox were kept separate.
    • Companies – one spelling per company across all tabs.
    • Emails – format, typos and domain spelling checked; generic inboxes (info@, hr@ …) and personal free-mail flagged. Mailbox-level verification (whether an inbox still exists) needs a bounce or verification tool.
    • Nothing deleted – remarks found inside name or company cells (e.g. "Dnt Call", "Need to find another POC") are kept in Notes.
